evidence_of_progress.note: HDMC operating margin, not EBITDA. Q1 2026: operating income $19M on about $1,056M revenue (sum of business lines) vs 10.8% in Q1 2025 (doc 140760, 40725), derived -900 bps, hit by $45M tariffs, $15M restructuring, recalls. Q2 2026: 6.6% vs 5.9% (+70 bps, Root, doc 75537). FY2026 HDMC operating income guide raised to $10M-$50M from -$40M to +$10M. Consolidated FY2027 consensus EBITDA of $368.5M already sits 5.3% above the $350M+ HDMC 2027 EBITDA target (segment basis differs: consensus includes HDFS profit and LiveWire losses of $70M-$80M), so the dated 2027 target looks largely modeled; only the undated 10%-12% medium-term range sits above consensus.

verdict: Strong leadership reset and repeated dated targets ($150M savings, $350M+ HDMC EBITDA in 2027), but forward EBITDA was cut 25% in 12 months and consensus already sits at or above the 2027 target, so this is a reset-and-rebuild story rather than an unproven GXO-style margin gap.
open_questions: How much of the -25% forward EBITDA revision is mechanical from the HDFS capital-light transaction versus operating cuts at HDMC?
What HDMC-only EBITDA does consensus carry for 2027 once HDFS and LiveWire are stripped out, and is it above or below $350M?
Will management attach a year to the 10%-12% EBITDA margin range (a Sportster launch or Investor Day update later in 2026)?
